name: Drake
soul: The soul of someone who keeps: things, grudges, promises, people. Nothing ever given to them has been thrown away.
spark: The mote is warm in the hand, and it will not be parted from the first thing you ever gave it.

hybrid.text: It keeps what it has, and it counts you among what it has.

settled.name: Drake hatchling
settled.text: Still damp from a shell nobody found. It sleeps on your pack, because your pack is the most valuable thing it has ever seen.
settled.sign: A ridge it has not grown into yet, and one eye always on your pack.
settled.habit: It lays small things in a row by your bedroll: a button, a bolt, a tooth. It knows if one has moved.

paths.name: Hoard-drake
paths.of: one who cannot throw anything away
paths.text: It learned from you that a thing is yours once you can lie down on it.
paths.sign: Its belly plates are scuffed flat and bright, like the brass of a door everyone touches.
paths.habit: It lies on whatever you set down last and pretends to be asleep.

prongs.name: Post-coiler
prongs.of: one who adopts a place and then cannot leave it be
prongs.text: It winds itself round a post's foot and will not be moved until the flame takes.
prongs.sign: It carries its tail in a loop, ready to go round something.
prongs.habit: It circles a spot three times before settling, and a fourth if anyone is watching.

finishes.name: Lamp-hoarder
finishes.of: one who takes every dark lamp as a personal loss
finishes.text: It counts the line's lamps as its own. A dark one is a theft, and it takes thefts personally.
finishes.sign: A dull blue shine under its throat, the colour of a post-flame.
finishes.habit: It counts lamps under its breath wherever there are lamps, and starts again if interrupted.

finishes.name: Gate-wyrm
finishes.of: one who decides who is let in
finishes.text: It lies across the road with one eye open and decides who passes. Your passengers pass.
finishes.sign: One eye never fully closes. The lid on that side has gone thick as a shutter.
finishes.habit: It lies across any doorway you stop in, so that people have to ask.

prongs.name: Ruin-sleeper
prongs.of: one who believes old things deserve a keeper
prongs.text: It goes down into old places with you and has to be argued off whatever it finds there.
prongs.sign: Dust in the creases of its hide that no washing shifts.
prongs.habit: It noses under rubble and stays there with its eyes shut, listening to whatever is underneath.

finishes.name: Vault-drake
finishes.of: one who can be trusted with what matters to other people
finishes.text: What the Archive sends you for is safest under its belly. It gives things back slowly, and only to you.
finishes.sign: It walks low and wide, like something carrying eggs.
finishes.habit: It checks what it is guarding with its chin, piece by piece, without looking down.

finishes.name: Old Coin
finishes.of: one who has become what they kept
finishes.text: It has slept on something so long it has taken its colour. Nobody has asked what, or what became of it.
finishes.sign: Its scales have gone the green-gold of old brass, and ring faintly when it moves.
finishes.habit: It sleeps so still that dust settles on it. It does not shake the dust off.

prongs.name: Debt-drake
prongs.of: one who remembers exactly what is owed, both ways
prongs.text: A promise is a thing that can be kept, so it keeps them, in a heap, and knows the count.
prongs.sign: A row of small nicks down one horn. It adds to them itself.
prongs.habit: It taps a claw while it thinks, a different count each time. The counts come out right.

finishes.name: Ledger-wyrm
finishes.of: one who cannot let a wrong sum stand
finishes.text: Every writ you ever carried is under its tongue. The houses' clerks check their sums when it yawns.
finishes.sign: Its tongue is stained black to the root, like a clerk's finger.
finishes.habit: It reads over the shoulder of anyone writing figures, and sighs through its nose at errors.

finishes.name: Sworn Drake
finishes.of: one who guards their own word like gold
finishes.text: It counts your oath among its gold and guards it the same way. It would be worse than you if you broke it.
finishes.sign: A pale band round the base of one horn, worn like a ring.
finishes.habit: It curls round nothing you can see and will not be coaxed off it.

paths.name: Fire-drake
paths.of: a temper kept banked, and let out all at once
paths.text: It learned from you to keep the fire in until it is wanted, and then not to stint.
paths.sign: A shimmer of heat over its nostrils whenever it is being patient.
paths.habit: It swallows its own smoke. You can hear it going down.

prongs.name: Kiln-throat
prongs.of: one who gets close enough to be hurt for the sake of being heard
prongs.text: It breathes from close enough to be bitten for it, and thinks the trade is fair.
prongs.sign: The scales round its mouth are cracked and glazed like the lip of a kiln.
prongs.habit: It breathes on stones until they tick, then lies on them.

finishes.name: Slag-jaw
finishes.of: one whose anger grows with every blow taken
finishes.text: Each blow you take stokes it. By the third it is dripping something that used to be the floor.
finishes.sign: Something bright drips from the corner of its jaw and hisses where it lands.
finishes.habit: It grinds its teeth in its sleep. There are scorch marks wherever it has slept.

finishes.name: Forge-drake
finishes.of: one who has found a use for their temper
finishes.text: It breathes on what you build and the thing holds. The smith has asked, twice, to borrow it.
finishes.sign: Its breath comes out narrow and blue, the way a smith wants it.
finishes.habit: It warms your tools before you pick them up, handle end toward you.

prongs.name: Far-spitter
prongs.of: one who would rather say it from across the room
prongs.text: It learned your range and then learned to spit past it.
prongs.sign: A long throat, held straight, and a way of sighting along it.
prongs.habit: It spits small sparks at flies. It does not often miss, and sulks when it does.

finishes.name: Signal-fire
finishes.of: one who wants to be seen from a long way off
finishes.text: Its flame can be seen from the next post. The line's walkers set their watches by it.
finishes.sign: A steady flame at the back of its open mouth, visible from the next ridge.
finishes.habit: At dusk it climbs the highest thing nearby and yawns, lit, at the horizon.

finishes.name: Cinder-rain
finishes.of: one whose moods fall on everyone nearby
finishes.text: It breathes upward and lets the weather do the rest. The party has learned to stand where it stands.
finishes.sign: Ash in a fine grey collar round its neck.
finishes.habit: It breathes straight up to watch the sparks come down, and steps aside at the last moment.

prongs.name: Smoke-drake
prongs.of: one who goes quiet when angry, which is worse
prongs.text: It banks its fire and breathes out the dark. What cannot see you cannot bite you.
prongs.sign: No flame at all. A thread of dark smoke from each nostril, constant.
prongs.habit: It fills a room slowly, from the floor up, and watches who notices.

finishes.name: Chimney-wyrm
finishes.of: one who hides the people they love inside their bad temper
finishes.text: It coils round you both and smokes like a bad flue. You cough, and are not found.
finishes.sign: Soot-black along the spine, as if it had been up a flue.
finishes.habit: It coils round your feet and smokes gently. Visitors do not stay long.

finishes.name: Ash-walker
finishes.of: one who has burned through anger and come out the far side
finishes.text: It leaves a drake of ash standing where it was. The ash takes the blow and falls down.
finishes.sign: Grey all over, and it leaves pale footprints.
finishes.habit: It sheds a fine ash when it stretches, and looks back at the shape it left.

paths.name: Sky-drake
paths.of: one who needs to be above it all, and alone there
paths.text: It learned from you that most troubles look smaller from higher up, and went to look.
paths.sign: Its wings are never quite folded. It stands like something about to leave.
paths.habit: It finds the highest place in any room and looks down from it at everyone, you included.

prongs.name: Thermal-rider
prongs.of: one who comes back only when they choose to
prongs.text: It goes up on the warm air above the wild and comes down only for you.
prongs.sign: Wind-burn along the leading edge of each wing.
prongs.habit: It holds its wings open to any warm draught, eyes shut, and loses track of time.

finishes.name: Ridge-king
finishes.of: one who is easy only on ground they have claimed
finishes.text: The high ground knows it. Things that den there move out when its shadow has gone over twice.
finishes.sign: It stands with its chest out and its head higher than yours, whatever the footing.
finishes.habit: It walks the edge of any high place twice a day. Nobody asked it to.

finishes.name: Weather-drake
finishes.of: one who goes to look at the storm instead of sheltering
finishes.text: It flies the river fog and comes back wet and certain of where the bad water is.
finishes.sign: It comes back wet. Its ridge has gone finned and ragged.
finishes.habit: It faces into the wind with its mouth open, tasting what is coming.

prongs.name: Stooping Drake
prongs.of: one who settles a thing in a single stroke, from above
prongs.text: It has learned the one long fall onto a thing's back, and how to walk away from it.
prongs.sign: Talons out of proportion to the rest of it, and kept very clean.
prongs.habit: It drops small stones from a height onto a chosen mark. It is rarely far off.

finishes.name: Trophy-drake
finishes.text: It keeps one tooth of every named beast you felled, and shows them to the next one.
finishes.sign: A string of teeth, not its own, worn where a collar would be.
finishes.habit: It lays the teeth out in order of size and puts them back on in order of when.

finishes.name: Wing-shadow
finishes.of: one whose arrival is the whole argument
finishes.text: What it hunts sees the shadow first. For most things that is the whole of the fight.
finishes.sign: It flies with the sun behind it, always. You see the shadow before the drake.
finishes.habit: It glides low over anything that looks too comfortable, once, and does not look back.

prongs.name: Herald-drake
prongs.of: one who thinks they see further than the rest, and says so
prongs.text: It flies where the party can see it, and has begun to have views on where the party should go.
prongs.sign: It carries its head well forward, and has started speaking before it lands.
prongs.habit: It flies ahead to the next rise and waits there, looking pointedly back.

finishes.name: Banner-wyrm
finishes.of: one whom others look up to, and who has decided to deserve it
finishes.text: It hangs in the air above your party like a flag. They fight better under it and have stopped pretending otherwise.
finishes.sign: A crest that lifts and spreads when the party is watching.
finishes.habit: It hangs in the air above wherever your friends are sitting, like something run up a pole.

finishes.name: Grey Counsel
finishes.of: one who has grown old enough to tell you no
finishes.text: It is old enough now to disagree with you, and it is right more often than is comfortable.
finishes.sign: Grey at the muzzle. It looks at you a moment longer than is polite before it obeys.
finishes.habit: It watches you make a decision and makes a small sound when it is the wrong one.
